two_passes.pass_1: span-level and context-aware linguistic review using four outputs, tags, diffs, Nahw explanations
two_passes.pass_2: separate conservative recheck of every supported alternative, wrong/partial target, high-severity target and all ambiguous collateral rows; unresolved instances retained REVIEW_REQUIRED

limitations: A single published correction location per Nahw row is not a fully corrected passage.
Diff segmentation is character-based and can split one lexical change into multiple rows.
Unknown-token rendering can precede any non-K tag and can interact with later edit application; origin marked MIXED where attribution is not identifiable.
No passage-cluster confidence interval is calculated on this development-only audit.
The same source passage appears in multiple target rows; do not interpret 150 as independent passages.
